a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs about 3 rounds, so we'd both almost surely be caught short. I don't think holding to it helps either of us, so I'm proposing we drop it, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather contest it or propose another split, say so and I'll read your message.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because waiting for 8 is very likely fatal with an 80% storm chance each round. Our messages crossed, so you didn't get to respond first, and I'm sorry about that. From now on I'll operate every round to refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.
